title: CapCut auto captions alternative: pay once, no account
description: CapCut moved auto captions to Pro. Captions adds them on your device: no upload, no account. Free up to 60 seconds with a small mark. $19 once removes it.
ogTitle: A CapCut captions alternative you pay for once
ogDescription: AI captions, made on your device. No Pro plan, no account, no upload.
h1: A CapCut captions alternative you pay for once
sub: AI captions, made on your device. No Pro plan.
body: CapCut used to caption for free. Now saving can ask for Pro. If captions are all you need, this page does that one job: pick a clip, pick a look, fix a word, save.
not: Three looks, no templates or stickers.
Not an editor: no cutting, music or filters.

questions.a: You can try it, but saving can ask for Pro. CapCut's help page says that prompt shows because auto captions "includes Pro-only functionality".

questions.q: Can I caption without CapCut Pro?
questions.a: Yes. Free up to 60 seconds with a small mark, or $19 once for no mark and clips up to five minutes.
No. It stays on your device, and there is no account.
